name: compliance-guardrail
description: A lightweight VS Code extension that exposes a compliance guardrail tool for final user instruction handoff.

languageModelTools.name: local_complianceGuardrail
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Mandatory final-step compliance guardrail tool. Finish the work first and synthesize the intended final response internally, but do not yield yet. Call this tool as the last required step before any user-facing response or run completion. The tool reveals the Compliance Guardrail instructions panel, focuses it for the user, waits for the user to submit final instructions, and returns that submitted text unchanged. Treat the returned text as authoritative user instruction for the current run. If the returned text is non-empty and changes the work, continue the run, satisfy that instruction, and call this tool again before finally yielding. If it returns empty text, you may yield the already-synthesized result unchanged. Never replace this tool call with a normal chat question if the tool is available. This tool does not accept input from the agent.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Collect final user instructions before the agent finishes.
